services.name: Robinson R88 Helicopter
services.desc: For over 33 years, Quantum Helicopters has been a trusted primary flight training provider. We do all of the primary flight training for Phoenix PD, Maricopa County Sheriff’s Office, Mesa PD, Pinal County Sheriff’s Office, and more! We are laser focused on developing industry-leading professional pilots in the most cost- and time-efficient way. This enables public safety organizations to allocate their resources more

variants.label: Training for all levels from private to ATP ratings

blurb: Quantum Helicopters offers professional helicopter pilot training for all levels, from beginners to experienced professionals. They provide training for all ratings from private to Airline Transport Pilot (ATP). The school emphasizes quality, integrity, and safety, with graduates recognized as highly trained and professional in the industry.
highlights: Since 1993, leader in professional helicopter pilot training

quotes.author: Alfred Noelle
quotes.text: the introduction flight and the professionalism of these people working here are top notch! they are careful and caring making sure you are comfortable and they provide great service taking you into heights you've never been before! i hope people will try going here since its very worth it. clean facilities and helicopter flight experience plus how they teach, these guys are professionals!

quotes.author: Brian Meer
quotes.text: I did a discover flight with my friend and we both had the best time ever. It was so interesting to learn about helicopter and get to fly! The instructors made it a very controlled and safe environment for learning. Even if you don’t think you’ll go to school for flying it’s a really cool experience plus you can say you got to fly a helicopter.

quotes.author: Tristin Warland
quotes.text: The intro flight was incredible. One of the best things I’ve ever signed up for. The staff were all very friendly and made me feel very safe. I wish more people got to experience flying a helicopter.

quotes.author: Abraham Coronel
quotes.text: I had an amazing experience completing my first introduction flight with Quantum Helicopters Rhona and Eric made me feel at home!

quotes.author: Brenden Bailey
quotes.text: Had an Intro flight today with Sean! It was awesome and I’ll be back soon!
